title: services/report_export_service.py — ReportExportService
scope: ReportExportService with export_sales(format, date_from, date_to, dealer_ids, places, design_ids) and export_inward(format, date_from, date_to, supplier_ids, places, design_ids). Both: (1) validate format in ['pdf','xlsx'] → HTTPException 400 if not; (2) call respective report service to get data; (3) route to PdfExporter or ExcelExporter based on format; (4) return tuple(BytesIO, content_type, filename). content_type: 'application/pdf' or XLSX MIME. filename: '{report}_report_{YYYY-MM-DD}.{ext}'.

success_criteria.definition_of_done: ReportExportService exported with 2 methods. HTTPException 400 on unsupported format. Returns (BytesIO, content_type, filename) tuple. Filename includes today's date.

checkout_prompt: ReportExportService created. export_sales + export_inward. Format validation (400 on unsupported). Returns (BytesIO, content_type, filename). TC-200 covered. Ready for T-088 (router).
